prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: game-model albedo texture source for Lord Vhorrax's plasma saber.
Input image 1 is the edit target, an exact orthographic white model guide. Input image 2 is design_reference.png, the authority ONLY for surface design, colours and materials. Paint directly over input image 1. Output one 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background.
CRITICAL: preserve the edit target's entire alpha silhouette EXACTLY pixel for pixel, its size, position, orientation, every part boundary and cutout. The large transparent margins are intentional and must stay unchanged. Do not auto-crop, enlarge, recenter, rotate, change the camera, change proportions, add geometry, or show a different view. Keep every pixel outside its original outline transparent.
Paint the existing surfaces with the approved reference's warm ivory-white ceramic with fine wear, muted brushed antique gold, black-violet resin with flowing seams and incised lines, and orange/amber light with pale warm-white cores. Use the actual reference's material placements as the geometry allows; do not invent unrelated blue lights, fabric, paper or writing. Continue hidden surfaces plausibly in the same materials.
This is ALBEDO, not a beauty render: even flat shadowless viewer lighting, no ambient occlusion, no cast shadows, no directional shading, no hot specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light. Gold is base gold colour with only faint sheen. Luminous parts are painted bright colours confined to the silhouette: no bloom, no halo, no light spill. No background, floor, text, letters, labels, watermark or extra objects.
View-specific constraint: FRONT, looking straight down the long axis of the saber. The target is deliberately only a tiny horizontally pointed end-on shape centered at (511,512), with nontransparent bounds x=446..576 and y=479..544 on the 1024-square canvas. It must remain this 131-by-66 pixel shape, including the irregular left point, raised upper middle and thin right point. Colour that exact foreshortened guard/end geometry. Do not turn this into a full-length sword image; nearly the whole canvas remains transparent.
reason: Rejected: front object substantially enlarged, outline redesigned, and strong metallic shading.
